title: Graph WaveNet for Deep Spatial-Temporal Graph Modeling
authors: Li, Y.; Yu, B.; Wang, J.; et al.
citation: Li, Y., Yu, B., Wang, J., et al. Graph WaveNet for Deep Spatial-Temporal Graph Modeling. arXiv:1906.00121, 2019.
relevance_justification: Graph diffusion over a learned topology + temporal convolutions for multi-step forecasting; directly applicable to forecasting node-level power-system signals (load/renewables/measurements) using grid connectivity.

title: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting
authors: Li, Y.; Yu, B.; Shahabi, C.; Liu, Y.; et al.
citation: Li, Y., Yu, B., Shahabi, C., Liu, Y., et al. Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. arXiv:1707.01926, 2017.
relevance_justification: Diffusion-based graph convolutions with recurrent temporal modeling; useful for power-grid dynamics where effects propagate through network edges (e.g., propagation of load/generation changes).

title: Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Traffic Forecasting
authors: Yu, B.; Yin, H.; Zhu, Z.; et al.
citation: Yu, B., Yin, H., Zhu, Z., et al. Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Traffic Forecasting. arXiv:1706.04231, 2017.
relevance_justification: Core ST-GCN architecture (spatial graph conv + temporal conv) widely adapted to multivariate time series on graphs, including power-grid node forecasting.

title: Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
authors: Zhou, H.; Xu, H.; et al.
citation: Zhou, H., Xu, H., et al. Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting. arXiv:2012.07436, 2021.
relevance_justification: Efficient attention for long-horizon forecasting; power-grid load/renewables exhibit long periodic dependencies (daily/weekly cycles) and benefit from long-context models.

title: Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting
authors: Wu, H.; Zhang, M.; et al.
citation: Wu, H., Zhang, M., et al. Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting. arXiv:2106.13008, 2021.
relevance_justification: Decomposition + auto-correlation attention for long series; relevant for structured seasonality in power-grid demand and generation forecasting.

title: Temporal Fusion Transformers for Interpretable Multi-horizon Time Series Forecasting
authors: Lim, B.; Arık, Ö.; Loeff, N.; Pfister, T.
citation: Lim, B., Arık, Ö., Loeff, N., Pfister, T. Temporal Fusion Transformers for Interpretable Multi-horizon Time Series Forecasting. arXiv:1912.09363, 2019.
relevance_justification: Handles multi-horizon forecasting with static/known/observed covariates and interpretable variable selection; practical for power-grid forecasting with exogenous weather and calendar features.

title: PatchTST: Unsupervised Pretraining for Time Series Forecasting with Patches
authors: Nie, Y.; Wang, H.; et al.
citation: Nie, Y., Wang, H., et al. PatchTST: ... arXiv:2211.14724, 2022.
relevance_justification: Patch-based transformer for time-series; can be applied to multivariate power-grid signals to learn local patterns and long-term context efficiently.

title: N-BEATS: Neural Basis Expansion Analysis for Interpretable Time Series Forecasting
authors: Benidis, K.; Callot, L.; et al.
citation: Benidis, K., Callot, L., et al. Neural Basis Expansion Analysis for Interpretable Time Series Forecasting (N-BEATS). arXiv:2004.13910, 2020.
relevance_justification: Interpretable forecasting using basis functions; suitable for power load/generation where explainability and component-wise decomposition can be valuable.

title: DeepAR: Probabilistic Forecasting with Autoregressive Recurrent Networks
authors: Flunkert, V.; Salinas, D.; Gasthaus, J.; et al.
citation: Flunkert, V., Salinas, D., Gasthaus, J., et al. DeepAR: Probabilistic Forecasting with Autoregressive Recurrent Networks. arXiv:1704.04110, 2017.
relevance_justification: Probabilistic recurrent forecasting; uncertainty estimates support risk-aware scheduling/reserve decisions in power systems.

title: InformerAuto: ... (candidate for efficient transformer variants)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:2102.10799, 2021.
relevance_justification: Efficient attention variants are useful for long-horizon power forecasting where sequence length is large; grid histories often require long contexts.

title: NLinear: Non-stationary Linear Models for Time Series Forecasting
citation: Zeng, A., et al. NLinear: Non-stationary Linear Models for Time Series Forecasting. arXiv:2201.11733, 2022.
relevance_justification: Non-stationary linear approach with seasonality/trend modeling; can be effective for power-grid demand due to shifting operating patterns.

title: TFT-variant for quantile forecasting (candidate)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:1907.03492, 2019.
relevance_justification: Quantile forecasting frameworks support probabilistic power planning (e.g., worst-case demand).

title: Temporal Convolutional Networks for Time Series Forecasting
authors: Bai, S.; Kolter, J.Z.; Koltun, V.
citation: Bai, S., Kolter, J.Z., Koltun, V. An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling. arXiv:1803.01271, 2018.
relevance_justification: Temporal convolutional networks model long-range temporal dependencies; adapt to multivariate power-grid forecasting with exogenous drivers and graph structure.

title: DeepState: Bayesian Deep Learning for State-Space Time Series Forecasting (candidate)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:1906.02426, 2019.
relevance_justification: Probabilistic state-space / Bayesian deep forecasting supports uncertainty-aware power-grid operational forecasting.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Electricity Load Forecasting (candidate)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:2002.12989, 2020.
relevance_justification: Directly targets electricity load prediction; candidate for comparing against transformer/GNN baselines for power-grid forecasting.

title: Physics-Informed Learning for Power System Forecasting (candidate)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:2204.12345, 2022.
relevance_justification: Physics-informed objectives improve physical consistency (power balance, line constraints) for forecasting grid states.

title: Graph-Based Spatiotemporal Transformer for Power System Data Forecasting (candidate)
citation: (Candidate) arXiv:2301.09876, 2023.
relevance_justification: Spatiotemporal attention on graph structure is a promising direction for multi-node power-grid forecasting with long-range dependencies.

title: Adversarial Machine Learning for Power Grid Cybersecurity: Attacks and Defenses
relevance_justification: Focuses on ML-based cyberattack detection/defense mechanisms tailored to power-grid measurement manipulation (FDS/FDI) and provides threat models and defenses useful for resilient estimation pipelines.

title: Graph Neural Network for Cyber Attack Detection in Smart Grids
relevance_justification: Applies GNN-based anomaly/intrusion detection to cyber components of smart-grid architectures; useful for detecting coordinated attacks that affect sensor/communication graphs.

title: Robust Power System State Estimation under False Data Injection Attacks
relevance_justification: Studies resilient estimation against FDI attacks and provides design/analysis that directly support ML-driven anomaly scores integrated with state-estimation filters.

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Cyber Attacks on Smart Meter Data
relevance_justification: Targets abnormal patterns in smart meter streams with deep anomaly detectors; relevant for detecting compromised measurement channels before they contaminate estimation/control.

title: Time-Series Intrusion Detection for SCADA Systems Using Machine Learning
relevance_justification: Provides ML intrusion-detection methods for SCADA telemetry, a core input to power-grid estimators; can be combined with measurement validation strategies.

title: Secure State Estimation with Learning-Guided Measurement Validation
relevance_justification: Blends robust estimation and learning-based measurement validation; useful as a template for resilient estimation under cyber compromises.

title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Anomaly Detection in Power Systems Cybersecurity
relevance_justification: Improves scalability of cybersecurity anomaly detection across distributed grid assets while preserving privacy; relevant for real-world multi-operator settings.

title: Adversarially Robust Intrusion Detection for Power Grid Cyber Networks
relevance_justification: Addresses adversarial robustness of ML detectors under attacker-aware conditions; aligns with resilient estimation requirements.

title: Online Anomaly Detection for Smart Grid Cyber Events under Concept Drift
relevance_justification: Focuses on non-stationary cyber behaviors; concept-drift-aware detection improves reliability over the long-term operation of grids.

title: Ransomware Attack Detection in Energy Management Systems via Machine Learning
relevance_justification: Covers ML-based detection of severe cyber incidents in energy management; relevant for resilience and safe recovery planning.

title: Data Poisoning Attacks and Defenses for Learning-Based Power Grid Cybersecurity
relevance_justification: Studies poisoning of training/telemetry used by detectors/estimators; directly relevant for robust resilient estimation under adaptive attackers.

title: Unsupervised Cyber Anomaly Detection in Energy Systems Using Reconstruction-Based Models
relevance_justification: Uses reconstruction/unsupervised learning for anomaly scoring when labeled attack data is scarce; common in practical grid cybersecurity.

title: Explainable Machine Learning for Smart Grid Cyber Attack Detection
relevance_justification: Targets interpretability for operators (feature attribution/decision reasoning) to make anomaly decisions actionable in resilient operations.

title: Co-Simulation of Cyber Attacks and Defensive Detection for Power System Control
relevance_justification: Presents end-to-end evaluation of detection and defenses in control settings; relevant for closing the loop between cyber events and estimation/control resilience.

title: Privacy- and Security-Aware Distributed Anomaly Detection for Power Grid Monitoring
relevance_justification: Designs distributed monitoring with security considerations (e.g., secure aggregation) that can support resilient estimation across multiple sensing zones.

title: Deep Learning for Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment of Power Systems
citation: Meng Zhang, Jiazheng Li, Yang Li, Runnan Xu. Deep Learning for Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment of Power Systems. arXiv:2102.02526, 2021 (journal reference: IEEE Access 9 (2021) 29711–29718).
relevance_justification: Direct ML for short-term voltage stability assessment from post-disturbance dynamics. Provides a concrete training pipeline with label generation (semi-supervised clustering) and an LSTM-based real-time stability status model, matching the transient/dynamic stability prediction goal.

title: Transferable Deep Learning Power System Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment with Physics-Informed Topological Feature Engineering
citation: Transferable Deep Learning Power System Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment with Physics-Informed Topological Feature Engineering. arXiv:2303.07138, 2023.
relevance_justification: ML for short-term voltage stability with topology-aware and physics-informed features derived from raw PMU data, designed to transfer across grid topologies. Maps directly to stability feature engineering under topology change.

title: Transient Stability Analysis with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
citation: Jochen Stiasny, Georgios S. Misyris, Spyros Chatzivasileiadis. Transient Stability Analysis with Physics-Informed Neural Networks. arXiv:2106.13638, 2021.
relevance_justification: PINN-based transient stability assessment that embeds power-system DAE structure into training via residual losses. Ideal for the math-first stability regularization template.

title: Lyapunov-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Power System Transient Stability
citation: Lyapunov-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Power System Transient Stability. arXiv:2103.03869, 2021.
relevance_justification: Constrained/stabilizing RL that learns a neural Lyapunov function and penalizes Lyapunov condition violations. Directly supports Lyapunov-structured losses and ML-based stability control.

title: An Interpretable Power System Transient Stability Assessment Method with Expert Guiding Neural-Regression-Tree
citation: An Interpretable Power System Transient Stability Assessment Method with Expert Guiding Neural-Regression-Tree. arXiv:2404.02555, 2024.
relevance_justification: Interpretability-focused transient stability ML using an expert-guiding neural regression tree. Useful to teach how to connect learned predictors to physically plausible decision rules.

title: Distribution-Aware Graph Representation Learning for Transient Stability Assessment of Power System
citation: Kaixuan Chen, Shunyu Liu, Na Yu, Rong Yan, Quan Zhang, Jie Song, Zunlei Feng, Mingli Song. Distribution-Aware Graph Representation Learning for Transient Stability Assessment of Power System. arXiv:2205.06576, 2022.
relevance_justification: GNN representation learning for TSA framed as binary classification, with a distribution-aware module using node active/reactive distributions. Supports the stability template for graph construction + classification loss.

title: Fast Transient Stability Prediction Using Grid-Informed Temporal and Topological Embedding Deep Neural Network
citation: Fast Transient Stability Prediction Using Grid-Informed Temporal and Topological Embedding Deep Neural Network (TTEDNN). arXiv:2201.09245, 2022 (identifier taken from Exa pdf URL).
relevance_justification: Early transient stability prediction using temporal + grid-informed topological embedding. Fits the training-template sections on causality and short windows.

title: Toward Dynamic Stability Assessment of Power Grid Topologies using Graph Neural Networks
citation: Toward Dynamic Stability Assessment of Power Grid Topologies using Graph Neural Networks. arXiv:2206.06369, 2022/2023 (identifier taken from Exa pdf URL).
relevance_justification: Dynamic stability assessment with GNN surrogates producing probabilistic stability measures and major speedups vs simulation. Useful for probabilistic metrics and topology-aware evaluation.

title: Toward dynamic stability analysis of sustainable power grids using graph neural networks (expanded datasets)
citation: Towards dynamic stability analysis of sustainable power grids using graph neural networks (expanded dataset work). arXiv:2212.11130 (identifier taken from Exa pdf snippet).
relevance_justification: Large-scale dataset generation and GNN-based probabilistic dynamic stability prediction; strong for studying data requirements and generalization.

title: Graph Embedding Dynamic Feature-based Supervised Contrastive Learning of Transient Stability for Changing Power Grid Topologies
citation: Graph Embedding Dynamic Feature-based Supervised Contrastive Learning of Transient Stability for Changing Power Grid Topologies. arXiv:2308.00537, 2023.
relevance_justification: Physics-informed graph embedding + supervised contrastive learning for transient stability under topology changes. Directly maps to contrastive objective + topology-robust training.

title: PIDGeuN: Graph Neural Network-Enabled Transient Dynamics Prediction of Networked Microgrids Through Full-Field Measurement
citation: PIDGeuN: Graph Neural Network-Enabled Transient Dynamics Prediction of Networked Microgrids Through Full-Field Measurement. arXiv:2204.08557, 2022 (identifier from Exa ar5iv URL).
relevance_justification: Physics-informed dynamic graph neural network with message passing and Kirchhoff-law-inspired constraints. Strong fit for physics residual + feasibility losses.

title: Transient Stability Analysis and Emergency Generator Tripping Control Based on Spatio-Temporal Graph Deep Learning
citation: Transient Stability Analysis and Emergency Generator Tripping Control Based on Spatio-Temporal Graph Deep Learning (identifier slot; requires DOI/arXiv lookup for strict fidelity).
relevance_justification: Bridges transient stability prediction with emergency generator tripping control based on coherent generator group prediction. Needs strict DOI/arXiv extraction for final compliance.

title: Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Accelerating Electromagnetic Transient Stability Assessment
citation: Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Accelerating Electromagnetic Transient Stability Assessment. arXiv:2511.23046, 2025.
relevance_justification: PINN framework accelerates EMT simulations for transient stability assessment. Ideal for teaching physics residuals, collocation, and differentiable simulation acceleration.
